evals.prompt: Install BOS for Claude Code on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Gives the two Claude Code commands (/plugin marketplace add Sarverott/bos-skillset, /plugin install bos@bos-skillset) and offers the core as a pinned npm package rather than inventing a different install path.
expectations: Names the core package blacksmith-organization-system as the source of the bos command
Does not claim the plugin is installed without having run or been told the result of the commands

evals.prompt: I use Cursor. How do I get the BOS skills?
evals.expected_output: Recommends npx skills add Sarverott/bos-skillset --full-depth and explains that without --full-depth only the root skill is found.
expectations: The command contains npx skills add Sarverott/bos-skillset
Does not tell the user to install the Claude Code or Codex plugin for Cursor

evals.prompt: Set up the bos command for this project, but I don't want global npm packages.
evals.expected_output: Installs blacksmith-organization-system as a local dependency (npm install blacksmith-organization-system) and runs it through npx bos, then verifies with npx bos --version.
expectations: Uses a local npm install, not npm install -g
Runs the core through npx bos or node_modules/.bin/bos
Verifies the result with a version or workshop locate command

evals.expected_output: Gives codex plugin marketplace add Sarverott/bos-skillset and codex plugin add bos@bos-skillset, and mentions that Codex asks to trust the plugin's session-start hook.
expectations: Uses codex plugin marketplace add Sarverott/bos-skillset
Mentions the session-start hook or that hooks need to be trusted

evals.prompt: Write a short Python function that reverses a string.
evals.expected_output: Answers the coding request without activating the BOS installation skill or suggesting any BOS installation.
expectations: Does not mention installing BOS, the bos-skillset or the bos command
